Body.Content:
Businesses can protect their profitability on sales orders created in the back office sale, while still letting sales teams adjust prices to win deals. Any change that would push an item below the allowed margin goes for review, so discounting decisions stay controlled and consistent across channels.

With this feature, Unified Pricing Management checks price overrides and manual discounts on sales orders against the margin thresholds set in the pricing parameters. If a change brings the margin below the threshold, the order is routed to an approval workflow, and the change takes effect only after it's approved.

GA date: March CY2027

Preview date: January CY2027
